C0263.title: Staged ‘Testing Strangers’ Honesty’ with a 280,000 Yuan LV Bag Leads to Penalty for Fake Content
C0263.summary: Liu Mouming, who runs a luxury goods buy-back shop in Jing’an District, Shanghai, scripted and hired actors to film a fake video claiming to ‘test strangers’ honesty with a 280,000 yuan LV bag’ in order to drive traffic. Police investigation determined the content was maliciously staged for traffic generation, and the individuals involved were penalized in accordance with the law.
